# One rate: 1.35 CAD for a US dollar, on 2024-02-01.
#
# What this fixture produces: one price in the book's price database, so that
# the US dollars in a book have a rate and what is left without one is the
# book's shares.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_account_balance_reads_the_rates_the_book_holds.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2024-02-01"
	value: "1.35"
